C1794.title: Neijiang Police Crack Down on Order Decryption Case Involving Infringement of Citizens' Personal Information
C1794.summary: The Shizhong District Branch of the Neijiang Public Security Bureau uncovered a major personal-information infringement case in which a group illegally obtained and sold e-commerce order data through order decryption. Police arrested six suspects, identified more than two million leaked order records, and reported over eight million yuan involved in the case.
